root_cause.text: In `af_alg_alloc_tsgl`, when chaining a new scatterlist to a previous one that was completely filled, the end-of-list marker on the previous SGL’s last entry was not cleared before calling `sg_chain`, causing `sg_next` to return NULL prematurely and leading to a NULL pointer dereference in the scatterwalk.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `sg_unmark_end(sg + MAX_SGL_ENTS - 1);` immediately before `sg_chain(sg, MAX_SGL_ENTS + 1, sgl->sg);`, explicitly clearing the end marker. The commit message states: “fails to unmark the end of a Scatter/Gather List (SGL) when chaining a new af_alg_tsgl structure… This causes the crypto scatterwalk to hit a premature end, returning NULL on sg_next() and leading to a kernel panic during dereference.”
